questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A unit vector is a vector that has:
options: Unit magnitude and is used only to specify a direction
questions.explanation: A unit vector is written as A hat = A/|A| and carries no physical unit, which is why i, j and k are used to resolve any vector into components.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: On a pressure-volume diagram drawn from the same point, the adiabatic curve is:
options: Less steep than the isothermal curve
Exactly the same as the isothermal curve
questions.explanation: The slope of an adiabatic is γ times that of an isothermal, and γ is greater than 1, because an adiabatic expansion also cools the gas and so drops the pressure faster.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
questions.question: The momentum of a photon of wavelength λ is:
questions.explanation: A photon has zero rest mass but carries momentum p = h/λ, while hc/λ is its energy. This momentum is what produces radiation pressure and drives solar sails.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 11: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: The IUPAC name and symbol for the element with atomic number 105 are:
questions.explanation: The digits 1, 0 and 5 are named un, nil and pent, with the suffix ium, so 105 is unnilpentium. These systematic names are used until a permanent name is approved.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A reaction with a positive ΔH and a positive ΔS will be spontaneous:
options: Only at high temperature, where TΔS exceeds ΔH
questions.explanation: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS becomes negative only when the entropy term grows large enough, which is why the thermal decomposition of limestone needs a kiln.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: When methoxyethane is heated with excess hydroiodic acid, the products obtained are:
questions.explanation: The iodide ion attacks the smaller, less hindered methyl group by an SN2 path, so the halide forms at the methyl carbon and the larger group leaves as the alcohol.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 7: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In taxonomy, the word taxon refers to:
options: A unit of classification at any rank, such as a species, genus, family or order
questions.explanation: So mammals, insects and wheat are all taxa at different ranks. Systematics is the broader study of the kinds and diversity of organisms and their relationships.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 1: The Living World

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In anaerobic conditions, yeast converts pyruvic acid into ethanol and CO₂, whereas human muscle converts it into:
options: Lactic acid, with no release of CO₂
questions.explanation: Both routes merely regenerate NAD⁺ so glycolysis can continue, and both yield only two ATP per glucose. The lactic acid built up in muscle causes cramps.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 12: Respiration in Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Interferons, released by virus infected cells, help the body by:
options: Protecting the neighbouring uninfected cells from viral infection
questions.explanation: Interferons are a cytokine barrier and form part of innate immunity, so they act at once and against any virus rather than one specific pathogen.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: In human development, the solid ball of 8 to 16 blastomeres formed by repeated cleavage of the zygote is called the:
questions.explanation: The morula moves down the fallopian tube and then develops a cavity to become the blastocyst, whose trophoblast attaches to the endometrium at implantation.
